GetTimeText.notes: Formatting uses seconds/minutes modulo 60 and hours modulo 24; an hour or more displays hours. Input seconds are clamped then rounded by floor(float(seconds * 10000000 + 0.5)). SSE CVTTSD2SI returns INT64_MIN for out-of-range values. The elapsed branch is inlined because native clamps raw NaN to zero, whereas the existing elapsed helper maps NaN to MAX_flt.
